decisions.finding: Initial consonant Vav in וָיְמִיתֵם sits at cols 1521..1495, rows 466..538 of extension-volumeA-590-zoom4-lower-right.png on Line 3. Directly beneath its base at rows 539..552 sits an unambiguous T-shaped Qamats (horizontal roof bar at rows 541..548 with width 27 px at cols 1495..1521, and vertical descending stem at rows 549..552 with width 10 px, height 4 px). Note is retired with Qamats restored to initial Vav -> וָיְמִיתֵם.

Initial consonant Vav in וַיִּתֵּן sits at cols 1130..1115, rows 468..534 of extension-volumeA-590-zoom4-lower-right.png on Line 3. Directly beneath its stem at rows 540..550, cols 1108..1125 sits a clear horizontal Patah bar (width 17 px, height 11 px, min brightness 0), with sublinear space beneath (rows 551..560) confirmed completely blank pure white paper. Note is retired with Patah restored to initial Vav -> וַיִּתֵּן.
